# Dickinson Bayou Fleeting

> Barge fleeting, marine services and long-term waterfront dock leasing on Galveston Bay, the Houston Ship Channel and the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway, from yards in Dickinson and Freeport, Texas.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dickinsonbayoufleeting.com/): what the company does, lease rates, amenities, service area and both facility locations
- [Services](https://dickinsonbayoufleeting.com/services): every service offered, the lease packages and answers to common questions
- [About](https://dickinsonbayoufleeting.com/about): the company, its crew and the waters it works
- [Contact](https://dickinsonbayoufleeting.com/contact): phone, email and the inquiry form for the operations desk
- [Terms](https://dickinsonbayoufleeting.com/terms): terms of use for the website
- [Privacy](https://dickinsonbayoufleeting.com/privacy): what the site collects and why

## Facilities

- Dickinson Facility: 2629 Avenue R, Dickinson, TX 77539, on Galveston Bay with Houston Ship Channel access
- Freeport Facility: 906 Marlin Ln, Freeport, TX 77541, on the Gulf Intracoastal Waterway

Direct line: 713-859-0169
